'''Zircon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Zircon system/Legends|Zircon system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[Lothar the Grouch]] lived on the seventh moon.
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oscar the Grouch...Get lost!|[[Lothar the Grouch]]|<ref name="Insider32">{{InsiderCite|32|Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television|''Caravan of Courage'': ''Star Wars'' on Television}}</ref>}}
Zircon was mentioned in a ''Star Wars'' cameo on the television show ''[[Sesame Street]]'', which aired in [[1980]]. This [[W:c:muppet:Episode 1364|episode]] was chronicled in ''[[Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television]]'', an article written by [[Scott Chernoff]] that covered a range of ''Star Wars'' appearances on television.
